body: US stocks were mixed on Monday. The Nasdaq gained about 1.1% and the S&P 500 rose 0.41%, while the Dow slipped 0.07%. Tech led the rebound after last week's sell-off over doubts about AI spending.
Amazon rose 4.95%, Palantir 4.36%, Tesla 3.74% and Micron 2.95%.
Big earnings arrive this week: Netflix on Tuesday after the close, then Tesla, Meta, IBM and Texas Instruments on Wednesday.
dek: Amazon jumps nearly 5% as easing yields and oil help AI and chip stocks.
title: Nasdaq bounces 1.1% as tech recovers; Netflix, Tesla, Meta report this week
why: Indian IT and tech stocks often take their cue from the Nasdaq, and results from the big US tech names will shape the AI-spending debate that moved markets last week.
